test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In the following number-pairs, the second number is obtained by applying certain mathematical operations to the first number. In three of the four pairs, the same pattern is applied and hence they form a group. Select the number-pair that does NOT belong to this group.
solution:
The pattern used is (first term × 3) - 2 **= Second term****
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c754e6bf6f765c65cd814b473b2fe53ac958fdce17383ba37b51a9da846c4a7f.png] 

 

 

 

In the first pair, (24, 70)

(first term × 3) - 2 = Second term

(24 × 3) - 2 = 70 

(72) - 2 = 70 

70 = 70 Correct

In the second pair, (18, 52)
(first term × 3) - 2 = Second term
(18 × 3) - 2 = 52

(54) - 2 = 52

52 = 52 Correct**

In the third pair, (43,86)
(first term × 3) - 2 = Second term
(43 × 3) - 2 = 86

129 - 2 = 86 

127 = 86 **Inc**orrect

In the fourth pair, (39,115)
(first term × 3) - 2 = Second term
(39 ×3) - 2 = 115 

(117) - 2 = 115 

115 = 115 Correct

**Third**** pair does not belong to the group**.

 Hence **the correct answer is 43, 86.**
